name: Staunch the bleeding
description: Use an absorbant material to apply pressure to your torn skin and stop the bleeding.
success_msg: You apply pressure, and the flow of blood from the torn skin stops.

name: Staunch the bleeding
description: Use an absorbant material to apply pressure to your badly torn skin and stop the bleeding.
success_msg: You apply pressure, and the flow of blood from the badly torn skin stops.

name: Clean your torn skin
description: Use water to wash the torn skin of dirt, debris, and bacteria.
success_msg: You wipe down the area, paying extra attention to where the skin has broken.

name: Flush your badly torn skin
description: Use water to flush foreign contaminants out of where the skin has ripped apart.
success_msg: You wipe down the area and thoroughly flush the ripped open skin with water.

name: Bandage your torn skin
description: Apply a bandage to cover your torn skin from contamination.
success_msg: You apply a bandage to your torn skin.

name: Bandage your badly torn skin
description: Apply a bandage to cover your badly torn skin from contamination.
success_msg: You wrap a bandage around your ripped open skin.

name: Change aging dressing
description: Swap out the dressing on your torn skin.
success_msg: You remove the blood-stained bandage and apply a fresh one to the torn skin.

name: Set your broken bone
description: Realign your broken bone before splinting it so that it can heal normally.
success_msg: You realign the bone and hold it firmly in place with a splint.  Ow.

name: Poorly set your broken bone
description: Attempt to realign your broken bone as best you can before splinting it.  You're no professional, so you're going to have some permanent loss of function.
success_msg: It's painful and of subpar quality, but the bone is mostly aligned in the correct direction and now held firmly with a splint.

name: Splint your bone without setting it
description: Haphazardly bend your broken bone back into place before splinting it.  While the bone will fuse back together like this, there's going to be significant permanent damage.
success_msg: You hear a crack and an jolt of pain shoots through your entire limb that's almost worse than the initial break, before managing to fight through the pain and force it into the splint.

name: Splint your fractured bone
description: Firmly hold your fractured limb still with a splint so that it has time to heal without being aggravated and damaged further.
success_msg: You gingerly place your fractured limb into a splint, and let your body's natural healing process commence.
